text:
incident-bot: [P0] auth failures observed for customer 'evernorth' (private VPC) — 5xx from identity-proxy -> downstream pools rejecting client certs. Auto-escalation to oncall. PagerDuty: see PD#INC-4498 :rotating_light:

emma: ack. I'm oncall. seeing spike in 5xx: `401` and `495` from auth-proxy. Confirming impact: all workspace tenants in evernorth dedicated pool failing model calls.

josh: tagged — I can help with cert/mtls side. any recent rotations?

emma: not from our side. customer reported they rotated their intermediate CA yesterday. logs show client cert chain verification failures at our identity-proxy (nginx+mtls). sample log:

```
2026-03-15T14:02:07Z identity-proxy[auth] ERROR client_cert_verify: unable to get local issuer certificate (depth=2)
2026-03-15T14:02:08Z upstream[pool-a] WARN connection_rejected: TLSClientAuth: certificate verify failed
```

priya: looking at jwks cache — not related. this looks like mTLS client cert chain validation failing because our truststore doesn't have the new intermediate. customer says they rotated intermediate via their KMS-backed CA.

carlos: customer-side note from earlier: "rolled intermediate at 13:30, distributed to app instances" — they thought they updated the whole chain.

emma: triage plan: 1) add short-term bypass so downstream model-serving accepts bearer token from our identity service for evernorth until cert chain fixed; 2) ask customer to provide full cert chain and CA bundle; 3) rotate our truststore in a controlled rollout.

maria-cs: pinged customer SRE (evernorth-sre) for chain bundle + confirmation of CRL/OCSP status. they replied "sending bundle now, will confirm if they revoked old intermediate".

josh: mitigation option A (fast): update identity-proxy to accept `X-Redwood-Bypass` header for this tenant and map to existing service account (risk: bypasses mTLS guarantee). mitigation option B (safer): hot-patch our truststore with customer's intermediate and restart identity-proxy pods in canary then roll.

emma: i'm leaning B but can do A as emergency fallback if customer can't provide cert quickly. B steps below.

```
# canary patch (kube)
kubectl create secret generic evernorth-ca --from-file=ca.pem=/tmp/evernorth_intermediate.pem -n infra-auth
kubectl patch deployment identity-proxy -n infra-auth --patch '{"spec": {"template": {"metadata": {"annotations": {"evernorth-ca": "canary-$(date +%s)"}}}}}'
```

priya: note — need to update `truststore.jks` build if we want to bake permanent change. hot patch will use mounted secret + configmap overlay. watch logs for `verify_success` events.

carlos: customer sent bundle. i dropped it to /tmp/evernorth_chain.pem on bastion. checksum matches. they say no revocation.

emma: starting canary now. creating secret and patching 2 pods (canary=1/3).

incident-bot: deploy triggered: infra-auth/identity-proxy patch by emma @ 14:18 UTC. CI run: https://ci.redwood/infradeploy/7892

josh: monitoring metrics: auth 5xx rate down ~60% on pool-a-canary. good sign. still seeing errors from older pods.

emma: can everyone keep an eye on latency and token issuance errors? rolling to remaining pods in 5m if canary stable.

maria-cs: customer acknowledged & will keep clients paused for 10m while we roll. they asked for postmortem.

priya: after full rollout, we'll revert temporary config, add permanent CA into truststore build, and schedule a config sync with customer for future rotations. also adding a validation step to our onboarding docs: require full chain + KID tagging for intermediate rotations.

emma: handoff to josh for next 2h maintenance window — i'll go offline for meeting. josh, take PM. :white_check_mark:

josh: taking over. current status: canary healthy, rolling to remaining 2 pods. I'll run `kubectl rollout status` and coordinate with customer for final verification.

pagerduty-bot: PagerDuty: incident INC-4498 acknowledged by emma -> reassigned to josh. On-call notes attached.

emma: final notes before handoff — impact: all API calls from evernorth tenants retried during window; special billing holds for tokens issued in degraded window. will open followup ticket for permanent truststore update and postmortem.

josh: will keep thread updated. next update in 15m or sooner if regression. :wave:
